Lead PM — Credit Risk Models, London hybrid.

Fernbank (London, 110 people, Series B) is a consumer-credit lender for thin-file applicants. We're hiring a Lead PM to own our underwriting decision engine and the machine-learning credit models behind it — feature pipelines, model monitoring and champion/challenger releases — working with a team of data scientists. Hybrid, two days a week. Experience shipping ML models into production decisioning is a strong plus; consumer-credit underwriting experience is essential.

label_v2.edge_note: ML is a plus the profile doesn't mention: MISSING lowers confidence, it is not a gap
